title: Write and Evaluate Algebraic Expressions
focus: Write and evaluate expressions with variables

items.stem: Which expression represents "7 added to a number n"?
Maria has x dollars. She earns 5 dollars each day after. Which expression shows how much money Maria will have after 4 days?
Select ALL expressions that are equivalent to 3 × (n + 4).

Write an algebraic expression for the following situation and then evaluate it when x = 5: "The total cost in dollars for buying x pencils, if each pencil costs 3 dollars and there is a 2-dollar fee." Show or explain your work.
